verdict.rationale: Check documents an official MCP server, hosted remotely or self-hosted, that lets users operate the product through natural language. The docs say users can "use natural language to generate reports, manage employees, run payroll, and more" from MCP clients including Claude, Cursor, Copilot and ChatGPT, and they give example natural-language prompts. The setup also offers read-only mode and OAuth or API-key auth. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably in practice.
